title: Ball estimate for a product measure: ν(B_r(x)) ≤ ω_nrⁿσ(B_r(x − p_V x))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), and p_V the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto V (V.starProjection). Let σ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with σ(ℝ^P∖V^⊥) = 0, and ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(A) = ∫⁻_{t∈V}σ({y : t + y ∈ A}) dHⁿ(t) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n], lower Lebesgue integral over V). Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P and every r > 0, ν(B_r(x)) ≤ ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)·σ(B_r(x − p_V x)), where ω_n = unitBallVolume n and B_r denotes an open ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ν (ball x r) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * σ (ball (x - V.starProjection x) r)
